=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py, lines 425-430, function _trusted_git
  PROBLEM: The _trusted_git helper runs every trusted-source git command via subprocess.run without setting GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 in auth_env, without closing stdin (stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL), and without a timeout.
  WHY: An unattended workflow job could hang until the runner's job timeout expires, burning the full runner budget with no diagnostic output because stderr is redirected to DEVNULL.
  severity=high | confidence=[4]
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py, line 452, function _trusted_remote_url
  PROBLEM: os.environ.get("GITHUB_SERVER_URL", "https://github.com") returns an explicit empty string when GITHUB_SERVER_URL="" is present in the environment.
  WHY: ls-remote and fetch operations against a bare /{repo} path fail with opaque git errors rather than producing the intended fallback URL, and the loader disables the overlay on fetch_failed instead of applying the consumer's trusted overlay from the correct URL.
  severity=low | confidence=[3]
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py, lines 569-577, exception filter in load_trusted_overlay
  PROBLEM: The except-block enumerates a fixed set of failure reasons that disable the overlay; any future code path that raises a WorkflowOverlayLoadError with a reason not in the set will be re-raised via the bare raise on line 574.
  WHY: A future code change that adds a new error path without adding its reason to the filter would crash the staging step rather than disabling the overlay — the opposite of the documented fail-open contract.
  severity=low | confidence=[2]
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: AD-1 from issue #6290 — "Consumer overlays keep working, and PR edits to the overlay only take effect after merge." The fix must cover both review_autofix.yml and validate.yml (AD-3).
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml "Stage workflow support files" step (line 2636) — the step needs GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN in its step-level or job-level env so the loader's trusted-source git fetch can authenticate against private consumer repositories.
  Evidence of absence: The loader's _trusted_git_env (line 438) reads GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN; without either in the staging step's environment, the git fetch to a private repo returns non-zero, fetch_failed is raised, and the overlay is disabled. The validate.yml path exports GH_TOKEN at its staging step, but the review_autofix.yml path does not. The editor previously flagged this as BLOCKED (workflow edits are prohibited in this run), so it remains a known gap.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py, line 452
  PROBLEM: GITHUB_SERVER_URL environment variable resolution does not guard against an empty string value.
  WHY: If GITHUB_SERVER_URL is present in the environment with an empty string, os.environ.get returns the empty string instead of the fallback "https://github.com". This causes _trusted_remote_url to return "/{repo}", which Git interprets as a local filesystem repository path rather than an HTTPS remote URL, leading to invalid local path operations.
  severity=low | confidence=[4]
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py, lines 433-446 and lines 481-497
  PROBLEM: _trusted_git_env configures authentication only when GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN is present in os.environ, with no fallback to the checkout's existing Git credentials.
  WHY: In private consumer repositories running review/autofix, GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN are not exported to the staging step environment. When fetch_trusted_overlay_source runs git fetch against the private repository over HTTPS without credentials, Git fails with an authentication error (HTTP 401/404). load_trusted_overlay catches fetch_failed and sets WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_ENABLED=false, silently disabling valid default-branch WORKFLOW.md overlays in private repositories even though the local checkout has credentials configured.
  severity=high | confidence=[4]
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py, lines 425-430
  PROBLEM: _trusted_git executes Git subprocesses without disabling terminal prompts, without redirecting stdin, and without a timeout.
  WHY: When remote Git commands (such as ls-remote or fetch) encounter authentication challenges or network stalls, Git defaults to prompting for username and password on standard input. In an unattended CI runner where stdin has no user, Git blocks waiting on stdin and subprocess.run hangs indefinitely, freezing the workflow job until runner timeout.
  severity=high | confidence=[5]
- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh, lines 19-22 and lines 163-169
  PROBLEM: stage_review_runtime_support does not validate that CURRENT_REPOSITORY or GITHUB_REPOSITORY is non-empty before invoking load_workflow_overlay.py.
  WHY: If CURRENT_REPOSITORY is empty, load_workflow_overlay.py is invoked with --trusted-source-repo "" alongside --trusted-root. In load_workflow_overlay.py line 591, this trips the validation check requiring --trusted-source-repo when --trusted-root is provided, causing the loader to fail and terminating stage_workflow_support.sh with an unhelpful argument error rather than a clear diagnostic identifying the missing repository variable.
  severity=low | confidence=[4]
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Consumer overlays keep working, and PR edits to the overlay only take effect after merge." (Issue #6290, Auto-decision AD-1 and AD-3).
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml in step "Stage workflow support files" (lines 2636-2648) or credential fallback in scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff modifies scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh to invoke load_workflow_overlay.py with --trusted-source-repo "${CURRENT_REPOSITORY}", which performs a git fetch of the default branch. However, .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml was not modified and lines 2636-2648 do not export GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN to the step environment. Furthermore, scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py lines 438-445 only read os.environ and do not fall back to credentials configured on repo_root. On private consumer repositories, the unauthenticated git fetch fails and load_trusted_overlay catches fetch_failed and sets WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_ENABLED=false, silently disabling default-branch overlays.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

  WHY: For private consumer repositories, the bare `git fetch` at `scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py:488-491` cannot authenticate; `returncode != 0` raises `fetch_failed`, which the catch block at `scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py:569-577` treats as a "disable the overlay" outcome, exporting `WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_ENABLED=false` and falling back to stock prompts. The whole point of the trusted-source redesign — consumer overlays keep working after a merge — is silently defeated on every private consumer repo.
  severity=high | confidence=[5]
